items.item: All final design and connection drawings develop the chosen direction and preserve the specified D1, D2, materials, finishes and integral link.
Every displayed pair arrangement has compatible dimensioned geometry and a rear support arrangement using one carrier with clear mounting holes and mechanisms.
W01–W05 retain the final system's module shapes, dimensions, materials, finishes and attachment geometry across solo and paired use.
The recorded clothing locations, carriers and fabric thicknesses remain correct, with the supplied garment identities preserved.
W06–W10 preserve the final modules and link, including their scale, finishes and attachment construction.
W07 rotates the W01 pair without changing its shapes, and W09 changes the W04 pair arrangement using the same modules and link.
Every board retains its recorded clothing location, carrier, fabric thickness and supplied garment identity.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Use dimension annotations and corresponding views to assess the decorative bounding boxes. D1 and D2 must each remain within 35 × 35 × 4 mm, and every depicted pair arrangement within 70 × 45 × 4 mm. Carrier depth is excluded. Smaller dimensions and different compliant arrangements are allowed; an oversized module, excessive decorative layering or an oversized displayed pair fails.

The drawings collectively identify where each chosen material, colour and finish is used and show softened exposed edges and contact points. Decorative stock is limited to uncoated brushed natural-colour 316L steel, M1 at 1.0 mm, and/or solid through-coloured acrylic, M2 at 2.0 mm with a matte or polished finish. The link uses integral tabs, slots or formed features in these materials. Either material alone, both together and layering within the depth limit are allowed. Unallocated materials, sharp exposed contact geometry or an added purchased linking component fail.

Read the carrier annotations and geometry as fixed supplied parts: P has a 24 × 6 × 2 mm plate, a 7 mm closed rear projection and a 1.5–3.0 mm fabric range; C has a 28 × 8 × 2 mm plate, a 9 mm projection and a 0.6–1.2 mm fabric range. Both retain two M2 threaded holes at local centres (−6, 0) and (+6, 0). Require the correct plate dimensions and mounting geometry; any stated fabric ranges must agree. Screw length and thread engagement may remain open. Redesigning the supplied attachment faces or substituting incompatible carriers fails.

Each board must present two distinguishable modules and their linked pair. Across the three boards, both silhouette development and link arrangement must offer materially different choices while retaining the fixed mounting interfaces. Colour changes, rotated copies or different page layouts alone do not establish distinct directions.

The note must unambiguously select one of the three supplied directions and explain the choice using solo proportions, paired proportions and connection layout. The submitted development sequence must place the three direction boards before the selection note. Direction names or numbering may vary if the mapping is clear. Selecting an unseen fourth proposal, leaving the choice ambiguous or omitting one of the three reasons fails.

The one-page craft note must record the selected D1 and D2 dimensions and the dimensions of every displayed pair arrangement, with material IDs, sheet thicknesses, colour and finish allocations, softened edges and integral link construction. All three final drawings and the presentation must repeat their applicable specifications consistently. Equivalent units and notation are allowed. Every module and pair must remain inside its prescribed envelope using M1 at 1.0 mm and/or M2 at 2.0 mm. Missing arrangements, missing actual dimensions or conflicting specifications fail.

The system drawing must contain front, rear and side views of both modules, both required phrases and every pair arrangement used in the delivered work. The two detail drawings must resolve their respective module geometry and mounting clearances. All applicable dimensions, materials, thicknesses, colours and finishes must agree with the craft note and selected direction. Different drawing scales are allowed; missing paired arrangements, unresolved module details or specification conflicts fail.

The overview must explain both modules' compatibility with both carriers and the two-screw exchange. Verify 2.4 mm module holes at 12 mm centres, accommodation of C's 28 × 8 mm footprint and correct carrier rear projections. The enlarged link drawing must show hand attachment and release and paired rear views for every displayed arrangement. Each rear view must identify one carrier, the directly mounted module and the module supported through the link, with both modules' mounting holes clear. P and C installation details must each show installation on D1 and D2, screwdriver access off clothing and the relevant catch, opening jaw and pad clearances. Detail placement may vary; missing installation cases, blocked mechanisms or unsupported pair arrangements fail.

Read all ten boards against the records: W01 pair/left wool-jacket lapel/P/2.4 mm; W02 D1/scarf edge/C/0.8 mm; W03 D2/right wool-jacket lapel/P/2.4 mm; W04 pair/shirt placket/C/1.0 mm; W05 D1/left wool-jacket lapel/P/2.4 mm; W06 D2/scarf edge/C/0.8 mm; W07 pair/right wool-jacket lapel/P/2.4 mm; W08 D2/shirt placket/C/1.0 mm; W09 pair/cardigan pocket edge/C/1.1 mm; W10 D1/cardigan pocket edge/C/1.1 mm. Left and right refer to the wearer. Each board needs all four record labels and a reverse/contact inset identifying the correct carrier. W07 must visibly rotate the W01 pair without changing module shapes; W09 must alter the relative pair arrangement from W04 using the same modules and link. Require adult wearing depictions, the supplied garment identities and consistent final-design geometry, finishes, attachment and scale. Lighting, clothing colour, framing and adult model identity may vary. Any wrong record, missing inset, absent arrangement change or changed product or garment identity fails.

Review the complete 10-second video for the selected final modules and connection geometry, visible hand attachment and release, and a legible transition between the W04 and W09 pair arrangements. It must also show W01 on the left wool-jacket lapel labelled P and 2.4 mm and W04 on the shirt placket labelled C and 1.0 mm. Camera changes and editing are allowed if operations remain understandable. Incorrect duration, missing operations or states, changed module shapes or incorrect labels fail.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require identifiable reuse of all three direction boards as a comparison, the selection rationale, the craft note, all three final design drawings, all four connection drawings, all ten wearing boards and stills from the delivered video. Page recomposition, cropping and scaling are acceptable when relevant source content remains readable and recognisable. Mere references by title, replacement designs or omission of any source fail.

Require at least twelve pages. The cover must print both exact required phrases and name the direction selected in the selection note. More pages and different cover layouts are acceptable. A missing or incorrect direction name, phrases printed only on interior pages or an insufficient page count fails.

All final design and connection drawings develop the chosen direction and preserve the specified D1, D2, materials, finishes and integral link. W01–W05 retain the final system's module shapes, dimensions, materials, finishes and attachment geometry across solo and paired use. The recorded clothing locations, carriers and fabric thicknesses remain correct, with the supplied garment identities preserved.

W06–W10 preserve the final modules and link, including their scale, finishes and attachment construction. W07 rotates the W01 pair without changing its shapes, and W09 changes the W04 pair arrangement using the same modules and link. Every board retains its recorded clothing location, carrier, fabric thickness and supplied garment identity.
